ITEM 1 | Golden-brown breaded or battered pieces with crisp, flaky, irregular surface and light crumb texture, some edges slightly darker brown, piled in a mound on the right-center of the plate, roughly 10 cm across and 2 cm high, sitting on and among green leaves | 150
ITEM 2 | Mixed fresh salad greens with dark green and light green leaves, some reddish-tinged leaf edges, glossy with slight dressing sheen, spread across the right side and lower right of the plate, about 12 cm by 9 cm, flat and loosely layered | 70
ITEM 3 | Cubed roasted vegetable pieces, about 1.5 to 2.5 cm each, with dark purple-brown skin and pale cream interior, browned and slightly charred edges, glossy oily surface, clustered on the left side of the plate, about 10 cm by 8 cm and 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 4 | Whole small pale white-cream round vegetable, about 4 cm in diameter, smooth matte surface with a slight green stem fragment at one side, sitting at the upper left of the vegetable cluster | 35
ITEM 5 | Small pale green lettuce or leaf fragment, wilted and limp, lying at the top edge near the vegetable cluster, about 4 cm long | 5
